scope: One hundred complete October 2022 native card bodies reviewed:37 definitions updated and63 retained. Restore engine Storm queries, attack/spell/ETB dispatch, Riders of Gavony miscellaneous protection, Liliana Indignation milling legacy, Vanish into Memory upkeep return, card-name chooser interfaces, cycling suppression and target cleanup. Preserve native quirks, including Militia Pride x_value token quantity, PB_GY_ABILITIES_DISABLED cycling checks, Recoil hand-count guard and unchecked Flame Jab/Lavalanche resolution. Original source names/interfaces retained; existing private Liliana legacy declared before owner use. Full aligned assembly resolves Wall of Corpses resolution filter removal, Militia payment/token fields, cycling guards and Flesh Allergy engine calls.134 native callee identities,112 enum values,8 complete source dependency bodies and71 data ranges bound. Independent callees and gameplay remain separately tracked; no byte matching or whole-program equivalence claim.
